sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Canberra is a town in the central west region of New South Wales, located about 300km west of Sydney, and 190km north of Australia's capital, Canberra.
sentences.zh: 堪培拉（Canberra）是新南威尔士州中西部地区的一个城镇，位于悉尼以西约300公里处，澳大利亚首都堪培拉以北190公里处。

sentences.en: Prior to European settlement, the area was occupied by Australia's indigenous Wiradjuri people,
sentences.zh: 在欧洲人定居之前，该地区居住着澳大利亚原住民威拉朱里人（Wiradjuri）。

sentences.en: and in the early 1800s, as Europeans began sprawling out from the coastlines, the area was labelled unfit to settle, so a military depot was built instead.
sentences.zh: 19世纪初，随着欧洲人从海岸线向外扩张，该地区被认为不适合定居，因此改为建立了一个军事仓库。

sentences.en: It became known as a place to pass through when gold was found weSt.
sentences.zh: 当西部发现黄金时，这里成了人们的必经之地。

sentences.en: But when gold started being dug up in the surrounding hills, the town of Kiara was built right on the banks of the Lachlan River.
sentences.zh: 但当周围的山丘开始挖掘出黄金时，基亚拉（Kiara）镇便在拉克兰河（Lachlan River）岸边建了起来。

sentences.en: Despite the verdict from early European settlers that Kiara was unfit to settle, it became an area known for its rich agriculture.
sentences.zh: 尽管早期欧洲定居者认为基亚拉不适合居住，但它后来却以农业富饶而闻名。

sentences.en: The Edgel Cannery was built in 1943, where local vegetables were canned and sent all over, including to those serving in the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 埃奇尔罐头厂（Edgell Cannery）建于1943年，当地蔬菜在这里制成罐头并销往各地，包括供应给参加第二次世界大战的士兵。

sentences.en: Vineyards were later planted, and by the 1980s, Kiara was famous for its Chardonnay grapes.
sentences.zh: 后来这里种植了葡萄，到了20世纪80年代，基亚拉以其霞多丽葡萄而闻名。

sentences.en: In 1987, Kiara was still a very small country town.
sentences.zh: 1987年，基亚拉仍然是一个非常小的乡村小镇。

sentences.en: It was rich in history, but had remained a small community.
sentences.zh: 它历史悠久，但始终保持着一个小社区的规模。

sentences.en: With less than 10,000 residents, it was a town where everyone knew everyone, and things that happened took no time to be whispered across the bar at the pub or in the yard after
sentences.zh: 这里居民不到一万人，是一个每个人都认识每个人的小镇，发生的事情很快就会在酒吧的吧台边，或者在教堂后的院子里传开。

sentences.en: the church.
sentences.zh: （接上句）教堂后的院子里。

sentences.en: As far as violent crime goes, Kiara wouldn't rank at the top of any lists.
sentences.zh: 就暴力犯罪而言，基亚拉在任何榜单上都不会名列前茅。

sentences.en: It was best known for being the scene of the largest prisoner of war breakout in modern history, known as the Kiara Breakout.
sentences.zh: 它最出名的是作为现代史上最大规模战俘越狱事件的发生地，被称为“基亚拉越狱事件”。

sentences.en: During World War II, Kiara was the site of a prisoner of war camp.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，基亚拉曾是一个战俘营所在地。

sentences.en: On August 5th, 1944, Japanese prisoners attempted a mass breakout by charging through machine gun
sentences.zh: 1944年8月5日，日本战俘试图发动集体越狱，他们冲向机枪阵地，

sentences.en: posts, armed with only improvised weapons like wooden bats and sharpened mess hall knives.
sentences.zh: 手里只拿着木棒和磨尖的食堂餐刀等简易武器。

sentences.en: 231 Japanese soldiers and four Australian soldiers were killed.
sentences.zh: 231名日本士兵和4名澳大利亚士兵在冲突中丧生。

sentences.en: Over 100 Japanese soldiers were wounded.
sentences.zh: 超过100名日本士兵受伤。

sentences.en: Despite that wartime incident, Kiara wasn't a place where the locals thought much about violence or violent crime.
sentences.zh: 尽管发生了那次战时事件，但基亚拉并不是一个让当地人担心暴力或暴力犯罪的地方。

sentences.en: It wasn't something that was of great concern within the community.
sentences.zh: 这在社区内并不是什么令人担忧的事情。

sentences.en: Of course there was trouble, every community had its fair share of that, but it was very much a normal country town.
sentences.zh: 当然，这里也有麻烦，每个社区都有自己的麻烦，但它本质上就是一个非常普通的乡村小镇。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for many houses in the 80s to leave their doors unlocked.
sentences.zh: 在80年代，许多人家里不锁门是很平常的事。

sentences.en: It was just the way it was.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这样。

sentences.en: Safe.
sentences.zh: 很安全。

sentences.en: People looked out for one another.
sentences.zh: 人们互相关照。

sentences.en: But in the early hours of Wednesday, April 15th, 1987, the simple, peaceful country town of Kiara was faced with a crime so violent and so shocking, it would be forever changed.
sentences.zh: 但在1987年4月15日星期三的凌晨，基亚拉这个宁静淳朴的乡村小镇遭遇了一起极其暴力且令人震惊的犯罪，从此永远改变了。

sentences.en: Catherine Holmes, also known as Catherine Pollard, was born and raised in Kiara.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·霍姆斯（Catherine Holmes），又名凯瑟琳·波拉德（Catherine Pollard），在基亚拉出生长大。

sentences.en: After leaving school at 15, she moved away in search of work opportunities in other parts of New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 15岁从学校毕业后，她为了寻找工作机会搬离了这里，去了新南威尔士州的其他地方。

sentences.en: During the last years of the 70s, she lived and worked in various places before returning to Kiara when she was 21.
sentences.zh: 70年代末，她在各地生活和工作，21岁时回到了基亚拉。

sentences.en: Back in Kiara, she settled into her old life.
sentences.zh: 回到基亚拉后，她重新过上了以前的生活。

sentences.en: She was comfortable there.
sentences.zh: 她在那里感到很自在。

sentences.en: It was familiar.
sentences.zh: 一切都很熟悉。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before she met and fell in love with a local laboratory worker named Bruce
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她就结识了一位名叫布鲁斯·霍姆斯（Bruce Holmes）的当地实验室工作人员并坠入爱河，

sentences.en: Holmes, and the two married in 1981.
sentences.zh: 两人于1981年结婚。

sentences.en: They moved to the New South Wales central coast, north of Sydney, and had two daughters together.
sentences.zh: 他们搬到了悉尼以北的新南威尔士州中部海岸，并育有两个女儿。

sentences.en: After just a couple of years, in 1983, their marriage broke down, and Catherine returned to Kiara with their two daughters.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几年后，即1983年，他们的婚姻破裂，凯瑟琳带着两个女儿回到了基亚拉。

sentences.en: It was a sad break-up, but the couple remained amicable for the children, and although Bruce remained on the central coast, he visited his girls often.
sentences.zh: 那是一次令人难过的分手，但为了孩子，两人依然保持友好。尽管布鲁斯留在了中部海岸，但他经常来看望女儿们。

sentences.en: Catherine and her girls moved into a home on Jindalee Circuit.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和她的女儿们搬进了金达利环路（Jindalee Circuit）的一所房子里。

sentences.en: It was a housing commission home located in the north-western part of Tian.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋位于天（Tian）西北部的住房委员会公屋。

sentences.en: Catherine worked two jobs to support her girls.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳打两份工来抚养女儿们。

sentences.en: Part-time of a night, she worked as a barmaid at the Lachlan Hotel in the southern part of town.
sentences.zh: 晚上她兼职在镇南部的拉克兰酒店（Lachlan Hotel）做酒吧女招待。

sentences.en: But her main day job was in a factory at Edgell's Cannery, where she worked on the production line canning locally grown vegetables.
sentences.zh: 但她的主要工作是在埃奇尔罐头厂的工厂里，在生产线上负责罐装当地种植的蔬菜。

sentences.en: It was at Edgell's factory where she met Georgina Watmore.
sentences.zh: 正是在埃奇尔工厂，她结识了乔治娜·沃特莫尔（Georgina Watmore）。

sentences.en: Georgina was also born and raised in Kiara.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜也是在基亚拉出生长大的。

sentences.en: Her father died when she was young, but she grew up in an exceptionally close family with her mum and brother.
sentences.zh: 她父亲在她很小的时候就去世了，但她与母亲和兄弟在一个极其亲密的家庭中长大。

sentences.en: Like Catherine, Georgina also left school at age 15.
sentences.zh: 和凯瑟琳一样，乔治娜也是15岁就离开了学校。

sentences.en: She became a shop assistant for a few years, before she too moved out of the small town in search of other opportunities.
sentences.zh: 她做了几年店员，之后也为了寻找其他机会搬离了这个小镇。

sentences.en: She settled south in Canberra, where she worked various jobs for a few years.
sentences.zh: 她在南部的堪培拉定居，在那里做了几年各种工作。

sentences.en: But just like Catherine, she moved back home to the comfort of the small town Kiara.
sentences.zh: 但就像凯瑟琳一样，她又搬回了舒适的家乡基亚拉。

sentences.en: The town that she knew well, and where people knew her.
sentences.zh: 那是她非常熟悉的小镇，人们也都认识她。

sentences.en: Georgina wasn't married and didn't have children.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜未婚，也没有孩子。

sentences.en: She lived alone in a unit on Brougham Street, just a few blocks south of the Lachlan Hotel.
sentences.zh: 她独自住在布鲁厄姆街（Brougham Street）的一套公寓里，距离拉克兰酒店只有几个街区之遥。

sentences.en: Upon her return to Kiara, she got a job at Edgell's Cannery, and almost immediately, she and Catherine struck up a close friendship.
sentences.zh: 回到基亚拉后，她在埃奇尔罐头厂找到了一份工作，几乎立刻就与凯瑟琳建立了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: Catherine was four years older, but they were firm friends and looked out for each other.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳比她大四岁，但她们是坚定的朋友，互相照顾。

sentences.en: They often socialised together, and Georgina became very close to Catherine's daughters.
sentences.zh: 她们经常一起社交，乔治娜也与凯瑟琳的女儿们变得非常亲近。

sentences.en: So close, in fact, that Georgina would often work different shifts to Catherine at the factory so she could babysit Catherine's girls.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她们亲密到乔治娜经常在工厂里选择与凯瑟琳不同的轮班时间，这样她就可以帮凯瑟琳照看女儿们。

sentences.en: Catherine and Georgina were well-known and well-liked around town.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和乔治娜在镇上很有名，也很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Both were described as bright and friendly.
sentences.zh: 两人都被形容为开朗友好。

sentences.en: They were good people, and good friends.
sentences.zh: 她们是好人，也是好朋友。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, April 14th, 1987, Catherine's girls were with their father Bruce on the central coast, about a five-hour drive away.
sentences.zh: 1987年4月14日星期二，凯瑟琳的女儿们正和她们的父亲布鲁斯在中部海岸，距离这里大约有五个小时的车程。

sentences.en: It was school holidays, and the upcoming weekend was Easter weekend, so they were spending time away with their father.
sentences.zh: 当时正值学校假期，即将到来的周末是复活节周末，所以她们和父亲在一起度过。

sentences.en: This gave Catherine the chance to work more shifts, and also have some time for herself and relax a little.
sentences.zh: 这让凯瑟琳有机会多排几个班，也能给自己留点时间放松一下。

sentences.en: That day, Catherine, then aged 28, and Georgina, aged 24, both worked a shift at Edgell's Cannery, finishing up at 3.30pm.
sentences.zh: 那天，28岁的凯瑟琳和24岁的乔治娜都在埃奇尔罐头厂上了一班，下午3点30分下班。

sentences.en: After work, they thought they'd unwind and have a few drinks, so they visited a few of the local hotels in Kiara.
sentences.zh: 下班后，她们想放松一下喝几杯，于是去了基亚拉的几家当地酒店。

sentences.en: Catherine first returned home and got changed, then went back out to meet Georgina.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳先回家换了衣服，然后又出门去见乔治娜。

sentences.en: They socialised with a few different people throughout the evening, seeing many people they knew about town.
sentences.zh: 整个晚上她们与不同的人社交，见到了许多镇上认识的人。

sentences.en: About 7pm, they headed to the Lachlan Hotel on Kendall Street.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点左右，她们前往肯德尔街（Kendall Street）的拉克兰酒店。

sentences.en: This was the pub where Catherine worked a few nights a week.
sentences.zh: 这就是凯瑟琳每周工作几个晚上的那家酒吧。

sentences.en: The Lachlan was a busy, lively Main Street pub, and Catherine was very popular amongst the patrons.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰酒店是一家繁忙热闹的主街酒吧，凯瑟琳在顾客中非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: She knew pretty much everyone there, and she and Georgina socialised with a number of different people throughout the evening.
sentences.zh: 她几乎认识那里的每一个人，整个晚上她和乔治娜与许多不同的人进行了社交。

sentences.en: They were both happy and in really good moods.
sentences.zh: 她们当时都很开心，心情非常好。

sentences.en: When the Lachlan Hotel closed at midnight, Catherine, Georgina, and four other people they
sentences.zh: 午夜拉克兰酒店打烊时，凯瑟琳、乔治娜和其他四个人

sentences.en: were with decided to go back to Catherine's place in Jindalee Circuit and hang out and drink some more.
sentences.zh: 决定回到凯瑟琳在金达利环路的住处继续聚会喝酒。

sentences.en: Georgina made a quick detour to her place on Bruham Street.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜绕道去了她在布鲁厄姆街的住处。

sentences.en: She grabbed some clothes so she could stay over at Catherine's, and also grabbed a small amount of marijuana, before heading to Jindalee Circuit to join the others.
sentences.zh: 她拿了一些衣服以便在凯瑟琳家过夜，还带了少量大麻，然后前往金达利环路与其他人会合。

sentences.en: Jindalee Circuit is on the outskirts of town.
sentences.zh: 金达利环路位于镇郊。

sentences.en: Catherine lived in a corner house on Jindalee and Victor Street, with green fields and grazing cattle close by.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳住在金达利街和维克多街（Victor Street）的拐角处，附近有绿色的田野和吃草的牛群。

sentences.en: Catherine and Georgina were joined at the house party by one other woman and three men.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和乔治娜在家庭聚会上还有另外一名女性和三名男性加入。

sentences.en: It wasn't a wild party by any stretch.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是什么疯狂的派对。

sentences.en: It was simply a small, casual gathering of friends.
sentences.zh: 这只是朋友之间一个小型的、随意的聚会。

sentences.en: They shared a few more drinks together before Catherine said she was done about 1.45am.
sentences.zh: 她们又喝了几杯，凌晨1点45分左右，凯瑟琳说她累了。

sentences.en: She had to work that day, so she said goodnight and went to bed, leaving the others to finish up.
sentences.zh: 她那天还要上班，所以她道了晚安就去睡觉了，留下其他人继续聚会。

sentences.en: Georgina wanted to go to sleep too, but the others weren't quite ready to leave.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜也想睡觉，但其他人还没准备好离开。

sentences.en: So instead of sleeping on the couch, she went and jumped into Catherine's bed with her, leaving the four others to finish their drinks.
sentences.zh: 所以她没有睡在沙发上，而是直接钻进凯瑟琳的床上和她一起睡，留下那四个人继续喝酒。

sentences.en: Two of the remaining guests left shortly after, about 2.30am, and the final two guests left sometime closer to 3.20am.
sentences.zh: 剩下的客人中有两位在凌晨2点30分左右离开，最后两位客人在接近3点20分时离开。

sentences.en: They left out the back door, leaving it unlocked.
sentences.zh: 他们从后门离开，没有锁门。

sentences.en: The back door was always unlocked, so this was no big deal.
sentences.zh: 后门一直都不锁，所以这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: At 3.30am, one of Catherine's neighbours was woken by the sound of a piercing scream.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点30分，凯瑟琳的一位邻居被一声刺耳的尖叫声惊醒。

sentences.en: This was followed by four or five further screaMs.
sentences.zh: 随后又传来了四五声尖叫。

sentences.en: Another neighbour was also woken by a scream, which he believed was followed by the sound of a motor vehicle starting up and driving off from Jindalee Circuit, but he couldn't
sentences.zh: 另一位邻居也被尖叫声惊醒，他认为随后听到了机动车启动并从金达利环路开走的声音，但他无法

sentences.en: recall the time of the scream or the car.
sentences.zh: 回忆起尖叫声或车辆的具体时间。

sentences.en: A third neighbour also heard screams, but couldn't recall the time either.
sentences.zh: 第三位邻居也听到了尖叫声，但也记不清具体时间了。

sentences.en: The police weren't called and nobody investigated.
sentences.zh: 警方没有接到报警，也没有人进行调查。

sentences.en: The neighbours didn't think too much of it at the time.
sentences.zh: 邻居们当时并没有多想。

sentences.en: On the morning of Wednesday, April 15th, Catherine didn't report for her shift at Edgell's cannery.
sentences.zh: 4月15日星期三早上，凯瑟琳没有去埃奇尔罐头厂上班。

sentences.en: When her neighbour, Robin Mulder, came out of her house that morning and saw Catherine's car, she thought it was unusual she wasn't at work, but Robin took it as an opportunity
sentences.zh: 当她的邻居罗宾·穆尔德（Robin Mulder）那天早上走出家门看到凯瑟琳的车时，觉得她没去上班很不寻常，但罗宾认为这是一个机会，

sentences.en: to catch up with Catherine for a cup of tea and to chat.
sentences.zh: 可以找凯瑟琳喝杯茶聊聊天。

sentences.en: At 9.45am, Robin's husband walked over to Catherine's house to invite her over to their place.
sentences.zh: 上午9点45分，罗宾的丈夫走到凯瑟琳家，想邀请她去他们家。

sentences.en: As he walked past the front bedroom window, he heard what he described as strange noises.
sentences.zh: 当他经过前卧室窗户时，听到了他所描述的奇怪声音。

sentences.en: He knocked and called out to Catherine, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 他敲门并呼喊凯瑟琳，但没有人回应。

sentences.en: He returned home and he and Robin thought that although it seemed strange, there must have been an explanation.
sentences.zh: 他回到家，他和罗宾认为虽然看起来很奇怪，但一定有什么解释。

sentences.en: But as the morning went on, both Robin and her husband felt something was a little off.
sentences.zh: 但随着上午过去，罗宾和她丈夫都觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: So by lunchtime, when there was still no movement at Catherine's house, Robin went and got another neighbour, Leslie Marsh, and they walked over to Catherine's together.
sentences.zh: 到了午餐时间，凯瑟琳家依然没有任何动静，罗宾找来了另一位邻居莱斯利·马什（Leslie Marsh），他们一起走到凯瑟琳家。

sentences.en: They called out at the front door, but again no one answered.
sentences.zh: 他们在前门呼喊，但依然无人应答。

sentences.en: Remembering her husband describing strange noises coming from the bedroom, Robin decided to check there.
sentences.zh: 想起丈夫描述卧室里传出的奇怪声音，罗宾决定去那里查看。

sentences.en: She heard what she thought was snoring.
sentences.zh: 她听到了她认为是打鼾的声音。

sentences.en: Surprised Catherine was still asleep, Robin called out again and tried to wake her up.
sentences.zh: 罗宾很惊讶凯瑟琳还在睡觉，于是又喊了几声，试图叫醒她。

sentences.en: She and Leslie then looked through the window.
sentences.zh: 她和莱斯利随后透过窗户往里看。

sentences.en: For a moment, both Robin and Leslie thought Catherine was playing a joke on them.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，罗宾和莱斯利都以为凯瑟琳在跟她们开玩笑。

sentences.en: It looked like there was blood everywhere, but it didn't seem real, so they continued to call out.
sentences.zh: 看起来到处都是血，但似乎不像是真的，所以她们继续呼喊。

sentences.en: And then panic set in.
sentences.zh: 然后恐慌袭来。

sentences.en: They saw two blood-soaked bodies, one lying on the bed and one on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她们看到了两具血迹斑斑的尸体，一具躺在床上，一具躺在地上。

sentences.en: Blood covered the bed, the furniture, and the walls.
sentences.zh: 鲜血覆盖了床、家具和墙壁。

sentences.en: Robin and Leslie immediately ran to the back door and straight inside the house.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和莱斯利立即跑向后门，直接冲进屋里。

sentences.en: The back door and the back flyscreen door were both wide open.
sentences.zh: 后门和后纱门都大开着。

sentences.en: The screen door was actually propped open using the pneumatic door closer.
sentences.zh: 纱门实际上是用气动门闭合器撑开的。

sentences.en: Someone had deliberately kept that door open.
sentences.zh: 有人故意让那扇门保持开启。

sentences.en: What Robin and Leslie discovered in the main bedroom were the bodies of Catherine Holmes and
sentences.zh: 罗宾和莱斯利在主卧室里发现的是凯瑟琳·霍姆斯和

sentences.en: Georgina Watmore.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜·沃特莫尔的遗体。

sentences.en: The noises that Robin's husband had heard earlier that morning were coming from Georgina.
sentences.zh: 罗宾的丈夫那天早上早些时候听到的声音是乔治娜发出的。

sentences.en: She was struggling to hold on to life, and the gurgling noises were her fighting to breathe through all of the blood.
sentences.zh: 她当时正在挣扎着求生，喉咙里的咕噜声是她在血泊中努力呼吸的声音。

sentences.en: She was alive, but barely.
sentences.zh: 她还活着，但已奄奄一息。

sentences.en: Catherine was dead.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳已经死了。

sentences.en: They immediately called an ambulance and the police.
sentences.zh: 她们立即拨打了救护车和报警电话。

sentences.en: Cowra paramedics arrived and rushed Georgina to hospital.
sentences.zh: 考拉（Cowra）的医护人员赶到并将乔治娜送往医院。

sentences.en: But she was dead on arrival.
sentences.zh: 但她到达医院时已经死亡。

sentences.en: When police arrived at the house, a child's bike was lying in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达现场时，车道上躺着一辆儿童自行车。

sentences.en: A crime scene was established, and police cordoned off the home, putting up palings around the edge of the property to hold up a barrier to keep sightseers away.
sentences.zh: 警方封锁了现场，在房产边缘竖起栅栏，设置了障碍物以阻挡围观者。

sentences.en: The neighbourhood had never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 这个社区从未见过这样的事情。

sentences.en: The crime scene was gruesome.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场惨不忍睹。

sentences.en: One of the first officers on the scene said it was a sight that would live in his memory for a long time.
sentences.zh: 首批到达现场的警官之一说，这一幕将长久地留在他的记忆中。

sentences.en: And even senior police officers commented that the crime scene was one of the most gruesome they had ever encountered.
sentences.zh: 甚至连高级警官也评论说，这是他们所见过的最惨烈的犯罪现场之一。

sentences.en: Catherine's house was placed under police guard for several days as the crime scene examination was carried out.
sentences.zh: 在进行犯罪现场勘查期间，凯瑟琳的房子被警方守卫了几天。

sentences.en: They discovered partial fingerprints in the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他们在主卧室发现了部分指纹。

sentences.en: There was no match on the police system and no match to anyone in the house.
sentences.zh: 警方系统中没有匹配记录，与屋内的任何人也不匹配。

sentences.en: They may have belonged to the previous tenants, or they may have belonged to the killer, whose prints weren't on record.
sentences.zh: 它们可能属于之前的租户，也可能属于凶手，而凶手的指纹并未被记录在案。

sentences.en: There was no way of knowing for sure.
sentences.zh: 无法确定。

sentences.en: The killer left a blood trail in the victim's blood.
sentences.zh: 凶手在受害者的血泊中留下了一条血迹。

sentences.en: The blood trail led from the bedroom, through the laundry, out the back door, and continued up to the front of the house where it ended at the road.
sentences.zh: 血迹从卧室穿过洗衣房，从后门出去，一直延伸到房子前面，最后在马路边消失。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry at all.
sentences.zh: 没有任何强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Police believe the killer may have been aware Catherine left her back door unlocked.
sentences.zh: 警方认为凶手可能知道凯瑟琳不锁后门。

sentences.en: The theory being that the killer entered through the unlocked door, then propped open the screen door, leaving both doors wide open to allow a quick escape.
sentences.zh: 理论是凶手从没锁的门进入，然后用气动装置撑开纱门，让两扇门都大开着以便快速逃离。

sentences.en: Partial footprints were also located, but they weren't caused by a shoe.
sentences.zh: 现场还发现了部分脚印，但并非鞋子留下的。

sentences.en: Police believe after entering through the back door, the killer took off their shoes, allowing them to creep up on the bedroom more quietly.
sentences.zh: 警方认为，凶手从后门进入后脱掉了鞋子，以便能更安静地潜入卧室。

sentences.en: The signs were pointing to a level of planning and premeditation, but in the immediate aftermath of the murder, there was no clue why anyone would want Catherine and Georgina dead.
sentences.zh: 种种迹象表明这是一起有预谋、有计划的犯罪，但在谋杀案发生后的第一时间，没有任何线索能解释为什么有人想置凯瑟琳和乔治娜于死地。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: The vicious attacks in the dead of the night in a quiet and safe town brought a lot of media attention.
sentences.zh: 在一个安静安全的小镇，深夜发生的残暴袭击引起了媒体的广泛关注。

sentences.en: Early reports said that they were hacked to death, their severe head injuries thought to be caused by a sharp heavy object,
sentences.zh: 早期报道称她们是被乱刀砍死的，严重的头部伤口被认为是由沉重的利器造成的，

sentences.en: with the early suggestion being that it could have been an axe.
sentences.zh: 最初有人猜测可能是斧头。

sentences.en: So from the very first day, the crimes were referred to as the Cowra Axe Murders.
sentences.zh: 因此从第一天起，这起罪案就被称为“考拉斧头谋杀案”。

sentences.en: But other reports also suggested a meat cleaver, a tomahawk or a machete could also have caused the injuries.
sentences.zh: 但也有其他报道称，切肉刀、战斧或大砍刀也可能造成这些伤口。

sentences.en: But examinations showed otherwise.
sentences.zh: 然而检查结果并非如此。

sentences.en: Due to the severity of the blows, the killer left indentations on the wooden bed frame, showing that the weapon was likely a blunt, hard, solid object,
sentences.zh: 由于打击力度极大，凶手在木制床架上留下了凹痕，这表明凶器很可能是一种钝、硬、坚固的物体，

sentences.en: like a tire iron, not an axe.
sentences.zh: 比如轮胎撬棍，而不是斧头。

sentences.en: They were bludgeoned to death.
sentences.zh: 她们是被钝器击打致死的。

sentences.en: The post-mortem examinations determined that Catherine and Georgina died as a result of severe head injuries, respiratory failure and blood loss.
sentences.zh: 尸检确定凯瑟琳和乔治娜死于严重的头部损伤、呼吸衰竭和失血过多。

sentences.en: Catherine suffered lacerations to her forehead and scalp and defensive wounds to her hands.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的前额和头皮有裂伤，手上也有防御性伤口。

sentences.en: Georgina suffered severe lacerations to her mouth, neck and right side of her head, and she had minor defensive wounds to the back of her hands.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜的嘴部、颈部和右侧头部有严重裂伤，手背上有轻微的防御性伤口。

sentences.en: The level of violence inflicted on Catherine was far greater than on Georgina.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳所受的暴力程度远高于乔治娜。

sentences.en: Catherine was struck 15 times.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳被击中了15次。

sentences.en: Georgina was struck 5.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜被击中了5次。

sentences.en: The wounds Catherine suffered were far more horrific.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳所受的伤要惨烈得多。

sentences.en: It appeared she may have been the main target.
sentences.zh: 看来她可能是主要目标。

sentences.en: Local detectives from Cowra and the nearby towns of Forbes and Young were joined in the investigation by six detectives from the state's homicide squad.
sentences.zh: 来自考拉及附近福布斯和杨镇的当地侦探，与州凶杀案调查组的六名侦探一起参与了调查。

sentences.en: A large-scale search was immediately put into action.
sentences.zh: 大规模搜查随即展开。

sentences.en: Their main goal was to try to find the murder weapon and any dumped clothing or other evidence from the killer.
sentences.zh: 他们的主要目标是寻找凶器，以及凶手丢弃的衣物或其他证据。

sentences.en: Officers from the tactical response group were called in to assist in the search and they checked every house and every yard surrounding Catherine's.
sentences.zh: 战术响应小组的警员被召集协助搜查，他们检查了凯瑟琳家周围的每一栋房子和每一个院子。

sentences.en: They also went through drains and waterways and moved onto properties and paddocks in the wider surrounding area.
sentences.zh: 他们还搜查了排水沟和水道，并进入了更广阔周边地区的房产和围场。

sentences.en: Police divers were called in to search the Lachlan River and other nearby waterways and daMs.
sentences.zh: 警方潜水员被召集来搜查拉克兰河及附近的其他水道和水坝。

sentences.en: The flow of Cowra's entire water supply from the local dam was actually stopped, which lowered the water level in the Lachlan River
sentences.zh: 考拉当地水坝的整个供水流量实际上被切断了，这降低了拉克兰河的水位，

sentences.en: to make the search easier, but it proved fruitless.
sentences.zh: 以便于搜查，但结果一无所获。

sentences.en: Police searched the grounds of Edgill's cannery where Catherine and Georgina worked.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了凯瑟琳和乔治娜工作的埃奇尔罐头厂的场地。

sentences.en: They also searched the local abattoir, including employee lockers.
sentences.zh: 他们还搜查了当地的屠宰场，包括员工储物柜。

sentences.en: They searched the local tip and other known dumping grounds.
sentences.zh: 他们搜查了当地垃圾场和其他已知的倾倒地。

sentences.en: But they found nothing.
sentences.zh: 但他们什么也没找到。

sentences.en: Catherine's ex-husband, Bruce Holmes, was cleared.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的前夫布鲁斯·霍姆斯被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: He was at home on the central coast with their children.
sentences.zh: 案发时他正和孩子们在中央海岸的家中。

sentences.en: The murder of Catherine came as a huge shock and Bruce struggled to come to terms with it.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的遇害令人震惊，布鲁斯难以接受这个事实。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Kathy didn't seem like a person to make too many enemies.
sentences.zh: 凯西看起来不像是个会结下太多仇怨的人。

sentences.en: I can't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解。

sentences.en: It's going to be hard for the children.
sentences.zh: 这对孩子们来说会很难受。

sentences.en: They were pretty fond of Georgina too.
sentences.zh: 他们也很喜欢乔治娜。

sentences.en: Bruce's mother, Thelma Holmes, said,
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的母亲塞尔玛·霍姆斯说，

sentences.en: Kathy could do no wrong by me.
sentences.zh: 凯西对我来说无可挑剔。

sentences.en: She was a lovely person.
sentences.zh: 她是个可爱的人。

sentences.en: If anybody knows any more about what has happened, they should tell the police.
sentences.zh: 如果有人知道更多关于这件事的情况，应该告诉警察。

sentences.en: Detectives began focusing on the community.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始将重点转向社区。

sentences.en: A gas pipeline was under construction nearby and a large number of workers from outside the area were employed there.
sentences.zh: 附近正在修建一条天然气管道，雇佣了大量外地工人。

sentences.en: The criminal history of everyone working on the pipeline was examined.
sentences.zh: 所有在管道工作的人的犯罪记录都受到了审查。

sentences.en: Detectives were particularly interested in anyone with a history of violence towards women.
sentences.zh: 侦探们特别关注那些有针对女性暴力史的人。

sentences.en: Many of the workers were from overseas and this meant police were faced with the hard task of tracking criminal histories from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 许多工人来自海外，这意味着警方必须面对从世界各地追踪犯罪记录的艰巨任务。

sentences.en: With no immediate suspect or even a clear motive, detectives had to consider the possibility it could be the work of a serial killer who had possibly struck in other areas.
sentences.zh: 由于没有直接嫌疑人，甚至没有明确的动机，侦探们不得不考虑这可能是连环杀手所为，且该杀手可能在其他地区也犯过案。

sentences.en: Cowra lies at the intersection of three main highways.
sentences.zh: 考拉位于三条主要公路的交汇处。

sentences.en: It's a town many have to pass through and stop at on the way to other destinations in western New South Wales or northern Victoria.
sentences.zh: 这是一个许多人在前往新南威尔士州西部或维多利亚州北部其他目的地时必须经过并停留的小镇。

sentences.en: So looking at this was important.
sentences.zh: 所以调查这一点很重要。

sentences.en: But again, nothing came up.
sentences.zh: 但同样，一无所获。

sentences.en: Every way they looked, they seemed to come back to the feeling that the killer was known to Catherine and Georgina, likely known to their circle of friends
sentences.zh: 无论他们从哪个角度看，似乎都回到了一种感觉：凶手是凯瑟琳和乔治娜认识的人，很可能是她们朋友圈里的人，

sentences.en: and known to the local community.
sentences.zh: 并且是当地社区所熟知的人。

sentences.en: Detectives got to work interviewing everyone they could find.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始着手采访他们能找到的每一个人。

sentences.en: They went door to door and interviewed neighbours where they learnt of the screams and the car heard driving off.
sentences.zh: 他们挨家挨户走访了邻居，在那里得知了尖叫声和听到的汽车驶离声。

sentences.en: They tracked down everyone who had been in the hotels drinking at the same time as Georgina and Catherine the night of their deaths.
sentences.zh: 他们追踪了案发当晚与乔治娜和凯瑟琳在酒店喝酒的所有人。

sentences.en: Those inquiries revealed it was a happy and carefree night, there were no issues at all.
sentences.zh: 调查显示那是一个快乐无忧的夜晚，没有任何问题。

sentences.en: Georgina and Catherine were in good spirits and didn't have any run-ins with anyone.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜和凯瑟琳当时心情很好，没有和任何人发生过冲突。

sentences.en: Their work colleagues at Edgell's cannery were interviewed and police also searched employee lockers there.
sentences.zh: 她们在埃奇尔罐头厂的同事接受了采访，警方还搜查了那里的员工储物柜。

sentences.en: But again, no leads were found.
sentences.zh: 但同样，没有发现任何线索。

sentences.en: They identified the four people who had gone back to Catherine's house for the party after closing time.
sentences.zh: 他们确定了关门后去凯瑟琳家参加聚会的那四个人。

sentences.en: They were extensively interviewed, but all were eventually cleared of any involvement.
sentences.zh: 他们受到了广泛的询问，但最终都被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: There were no issues in the house between anyone that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上屋里的人之间没有任何问题。

sentences.en: It was a completely drama-free event.
sentences.zh: 那是一个完全没有冲突的活动。

sentences.en: Everyone was in good spirits and having fun.
sentences.zh: 每个人都兴致很高，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: Being a small country town, rumours started to flow around the local community about what happened.
sentences.zh: 作为一个乡村小镇，关于案发经过的流言开始在当地社区流传。

sentences.en: There were even whispers that the small gathering at Catherine's place was actually an out-of-control wild party.
sentences.zh: 甚至有传言说凯瑟琳家的小型聚会实际上是一场失控的狂欢派对。

sentences.en: Georgina's brother David told the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper,
sentences.zh: 乔治娜的哥哥大卫告诉《悉尼先驱晨报》：

sentences.en: We don't know what it's all about, but they weren't wild girls.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这一切是怎么回事，但她们不是那种疯玩的女孩。

sentences.en: And the night of the killings, they just had a few friends over for drinks after the pub.
sentences.zh: 案发当晚，她们只是在酒吧关门后请几个朋友过来喝了几杯。

sentences.en: Georgina was a good person and she had a lot of good friends.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜是个好人，她有很多好朋友。

sentences.en: The talk of a wild party is nonsense.
sentences.zh: 关于狂欢派对的说法纯属无稽之谈。

sentences.en: David's comments were supported by Catherine's neighbours.
sentences.zh: 大卫的评论得到了凯瑟琳邻居们的支持。

sentences.en: A lot of them didn't hear anything, but those that did described it as nothing more than a small after-pub gathering.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人什么也没听到，但听到的人都说那不过是一个小型的酒吧后聚会。

sentences.en: Nothing wild or out of control or unusual at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不疯狂、失控或反常。

sentences.en: Within three weeks, detectives had interviewed over 500 people and as the investigation went on, a few things did come up.
sentences.zh: 三周内，侦探们采访了500多人，随着调查的深入，确实出现了一些情况。

sentences.en: Two friends of Catherine's reported that they had been babysitting
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的两个朋友报告说，她们曾帮忙照看

sentences.en: Catherine's daughters only a few weeks prior to the murders.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的女儿们，就在谋杀案发生前几周。

sentences.en: They were at her house babysitting when they heard someone enter the house, walk through Catherine's bedroom and then leave.
sentences.zh: 她们在凯瑟琳家照看孩子时，听到有人进入房子，穿过凯瑟琳的卧室，然后离开了。

sentences.en: When Catherine came home, the friends told her what had happened.
sentences.zh: 当凯瑟琳回家时，朋友们告诉了她发生的事情。

sentences.en: Catherine told them she knew who it was, but refused to elaborate any further.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳告诉她们她知道那是谁，但拒绝透露更多细节。

sentences.en: Then one of Catherine's neighbours reported seeing a suspicious man wearing a cowboy hat sitting in the park across the road from Catherine's house.
sentences.zh: 后来，凯瑟琳的一位邻居报告说，看到一个戴着牛仔帽的可疑男子坐在凯瑟琳家对面马路的公园里。

sentences.en: Police made a media appeal for him to come forward, but he was eventually eliminated from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 警方通过媒体呼吁他出面，但他最终被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: One crucial witness who came forward was a 15-year-old boy.
sentences.zh: 一位站出来的重要证人是一名15岁的男孩。

sentences.en: On April 14th, the afternoon before the murders, he was walking home from school around 3.40pm.
sentences.zh: 4月14日，即谋杀案发生前一天下午，他在下午3点40分左右放学回家。

sentences.en: He was walking along Victor Street, which crosses Jindalee Circuit.
sentences.zh: 他沿着维克多街走，那条街与金达利环路交叉。
